page.layout: One block of text in a single column at the top; below it a woodcut ornament with the word LIBER beneath it at right. Running head at top with page number at left. Faint show-through text from the reverse side in the lower half, not transcribed.

main_text.p: inquit, quod audire minimè potuerunt, & sine vllo reatu contemti Euangelij ad inferos deuenerunt. Similia scribit lib. de Natura & gratia cap. 4. Cum his veterum dictis si conferantur phrases Nouatorum, videbimus pugnantiam è diametro. Atque hęc pro refutatione eorum, quatum instituti nostri ratio visa fuit exigere, dicta sunto.
main_text.head: LIBER

page.notes: The woodcut ornament (a grotesque face with rams' heads and scrollwork) is not transcribed. Faint show-through from the reverse page is omitted. The dashes at line ends "vi-debimus", "At-que", "quā-tum" are hyphenated line breaks; the first paragraph continues from the previous page.
